title: Opulent Creamy Ukrainian Fernbrake Pilaf
description: A rich and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring fernbrake, tempered with chocolate, suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets. This peppery pilaf is a show-stopping main course.
instructions: Rinse the fernbrake and soak it in water for 30 minutes before draining and chopping it into small pieces.
Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat and saute the chopped fernbrake until it is tender.
Add the arborio rice to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in butter and slightly toasted.
Add the vegetable broth to the saucepan, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding the next.
Melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval until smooth.
Temper the chocolate by stirring it constantly and allowing it to cool slightly, then set it aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, black pepper, and salt until well combined.
Stir the cream mixture into the cooked rice and fernbrake mixture, then stir in the tempered chocolate until well combined.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the saucepan, then crack in the eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs into the rice mixture and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the eggs are fully incorporated.
